requirements.quote: the load capacity of the temporary-use spare unit shall be at least equal to one half of the highest of the maximum axle loads
requirements.text: The temporary-use spare wheel and tyre unit shall have a load capacity at least equal to one half of the highest maximum axle load of the N1 vehicle.

requirements.quote: if its use is restricted to a specific axle mentioned in the instructions in paragraph 6. below, its load capacity shall be at least equal to one half of the maximum load of that axle
requirements.text: Where the use of the temporary-use spare unit is restricted to a specific axle, its load capacity shall be at least equal to one half of the maximum load of that axle.

requirements.quote: The design speed of the temporary-use spare unit shall be at least 120 km/h for types 1, 2 and 3.
requirements.text: The temporary-use spare unit shall have a design speed of at least 120 km/h where it is a type 1, 2 or 3 unit.

requirements.quote: The design speed of the temporary-use spare unit shall be at least 120 km/h for types 1, 2 and 3.
requirements.text: The design speed of the temporary-use spare unit shall be at least 120 km/h for types 1, 2 and 3.

requirements.quote: An 80 km/h maximum speed warning symbol arranged in accordance with the diagram below shall be permanently displayed on the outer face of the wheel in a prominent position
requirements.text: The temporary-use spare unit shall permanently display an 80 km/h maximum speed warning symbol arranged in accordance with the prescribed diagram on the outer face of the wheel in a prominent position.

requirements.quote: an additional warning symbol, identical to that described above, with the exception that the figure "80" shall be replaced by "50" and the wording "km/h" by "mph"
requirements.text: For vehicles intended to be sold in countries using imperial units, the temporary-use spare unit shall permanently display an additional warning symbol identical to the 80 km/h symbol but showing "50" and "mph" on the outer face of the wheel.

requirements.quote: Upper case letters shall be at least 5 mm high and the numbers "80" and "50" shall be at least 20 mm high
requirements.text: The warning symbol markings shall have upper case letters at least 5 mm high and the numbers "80" and "50" at least 20 mm high.

requirements.quote: the elements that make up each character of the number at least 3 mm line thickness
requirements.text: The elements making up each character of the numbers in the warning symbol shall have a line thickness of at least 3 mm.

requirements.quote: Lower case text shall at least have a line height of 5 mm.
requirements.text: Lower case text in the warning symbol shall have a line height of at least 5 mm.

requirements.quote: All text shall be enclosed in a border and be on a background of contrasting colour.
requirements.text: All text of the warning symbol shall be enclosed in a border and placed on a background of contrasting colour.

requirements.quote: The requirements of this paragraph shall apply to types 1, 2 and 3 temporary-use spare unit as defined in paragraphs 2.10.1., 2.10.2. and 2.10.3.
requirements.text: The warning symbol requirements of this paragraph shall apply where the temporary-use spare unit is of type 1, 2 or 3.

requirements.quote: When mounted to the vehicle for temporary-use the outward facing surface of the wheel and/or tyre shall exhibit a distinctive colour or colour pattern
requirements.text: When mounted to the vehicle for temporary use, the outward facing surface of the wheel and/or tyre shall exhibit a distinctive colour or colour pattern.

requirements.quote: which is quite clearly different from the colour(s) of the standard units
requirements.text: The distinctive colour or colour pattern of the temporary-use spare unit shall be quite clearly different from the colour of the standard units.

requirements.quote: If it is possible to attach a wheel cover to the temporary-use spare unit, the distinctive colour or colour pattern shall not be obscured by this wheel cover
requirements.text: Where a wheel cover can be attached to the temporary-use spare unit, the distinctive colour or colour pattern shall not be obscured by the wheel cover.

requirements.quote: The warning indication shall be by means of an optical yellow warning signal.
requirements.text: The run-flat warning indication shall be by means of an optical yellow warning signal.

requirements.quote: The warning signal shall be activated when the ignition (start) switch is in the "on" (run) position (bulb check).
requirements.text: The run-flat warning signal shall be activated when the ignition (start) switch is in the "on" (run) position as a bulb check.

requirements.quote: A warning shall be indicated to the driver by the operation of the warning signal referred to in paragraph 5.1.6.1. at the latest when one tyre is detected to be in the flat tyre running mode
requirements.text: A warning shall be indicated to the driver by operation of the yellow warning signal at the latest when one tyre is detected to be in the flat tyre running mode.

requirements.quote: Electrical failure or sensor anomaly that affects the Run-Flat Warning System, including failure of the electrical source, supply or transmission of the output signal, shall be indicated to the driver by an optical yellow run-flat malfunction signal
requirements.text: An electrical failure or sensor anomaly affecting the run-flat warning system shall be indicated to the driver by an optical yellow run-flat malfunction signal.

requirements.quote: with the ignition (start) switch in the "on" (run) position the warning signal shall flash to indicate a system failure
requirements.text: Where the warning signal is used for both run-flat mode and a system malfunction, the signal shall flash with the ignition switch in the "on" (run) position to indicate a system failure.

requirements.quote: After a short period of time the warning signal shall remain continuously illuminated as long as the failure exists
requirements.text: After a short period of time the warning signal shall remain continuously illuminated as long as the failure exists and the ignition switch is in the "on" (run) position.

requirements.quote: The flashing and illumination sequence shall be repeated each time the ignition (start) switch is in the "on" (run) position until the failure has been corrected
requirements.text: The flashing and illumination sequence shall be repeated each time the ignition switch is turned to the "on" (run) position until the failure has been corrected.

requirements.quote: The operation of the warning signal specified in paragraphs 5.1.6.2. to 5.1.6.4. shall meet the requirements in Annex 4
requirements.text: The operation of the run-flat warning signal shall meet the requirements of Annex 4.

requirements.quote: a device must be provided on the vehicle which permits the tyre to be inflated to the pressure specified for temporary-use within a maximum of 10 minutes
requirements.text: Where the temporary-use spare unit is stored in a deflated condition, a device shall be provided that permits the tyre to be inflated to the temporary-use pressure within a maximum of 10 minutes.

requirements.quote: A statement of the risk resulting from non-compliance with the restrictions on the use of a temporary-use spare unit including, as appropriate, a statement relating to use restricted to a specific axle
requirements.text: The owner's manual shall contain a statement of the risk resulting from non-compliance with the restrictions on the use of the temporary-use spare unit, including any restriction to a specific axle.

requirements.quote: An instruction to drive with caution and at no more than the permitted maximum speed of 80 km/h (50 mph) when a type 1, 2 or 3 temporary-use spare unit
requirements.text: The owner's manual shall contain an instruction to drive with caution and at no more than 80 km/h when a type 1, 2 or 3 temporary-use spare unit is fitted.

requirements.quote: An instruction to drive with caution and at no more than the permitted maximum speed of 120 km/h (75 mph), when a type 4 spare unit as defined in paragraph 2.10.4. is fitted
requirements.text: The owner's manual shall contain an instruction to drive with caution and at no more than 120 km/h when a type 4 spare unit is fitted.

requirements.quote: A statement that operation of the vehicle is not permitted with more than one temporary-use spare unit fitted at the same time
requirements.text: The owner's manual shall contain a statement that operation of the vehicle is not permitted with more than one temporary-use spare unit fitted at the same time.

requirements.quote: A clear indication of the inflation pressure specified by the vehicle manufacturer for the tyre of the temporary-use spare unit
requirements.text: The owner's manual shall contain a clear indication of the inflation pressure specified for the tyre of the temporary-use spare unit.

requirements.quote: For vehicles equipped with a temporary-use spare unit stored in a deflated condition, a description of the procedure for inflating the tyre to the pressure specified for temporary-use
requirements.text: For vehicles with a temporary-use spare unit stored deflated, the owner's manual shall describe the procedure for inflating the tyre to the specified temporary-use pressure by means of the inflation device.

requirements.quote: The test track shall be substantially level and have a surface affording good adhesion.
requirements.text: The braking and deviation test for the temporary-use spare unit shall be performed on a test track that is substantially level and has a surface affording good adhesion.

requirements.quote: The test shall be performed when there is no wind liable to affect the results.
requirements.text: The braking and deviation test shall be performed when there is no wind liable to affect the results.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be loaded to its maximum mass as defined in paragraph 2.9. of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The braking and deviation test shall be performed with the vehicle loaded to its maximum mass.

requirements.quote: The axle loads resulting from the loading condition in accordance with paragraph 1.3. of this annex shall be proportional to the maximum axle loads
requirements.text: The axle loads resulting from the loading condition shall be proportional to the maximum axle loads.

requirements.quote: the tyres shall be inflated to the pressures recommended by the vehicle manufacturer for the vehicle type and loading condition
requirements.text: During the braking and deviation test, the tyres shall be inflated to the pressures recommended by the vehicle manufacturer for the vehicle type and loading condition.

requirements.quote: The test shall be carried out with the temporary-use spare unit fitted alternately in place of one front wheel and one rear wheel
requirements.text: The braking and deviation test shall be carried out with the temporary-use spare unit fitted alternately in place of one front wheel and one rear wheel.

requirements.quote: if use of the temporary-use spare unit is restricted to a specific axle, the test shall be carried out only with the temporary-use spare unit fitted to that axle
requirements.text: Where the use of the temporary-use spare unit is restricted to a specific axle, the test shall be carried out only with the unit fitted to that axle.

requirements.quote: The test shall be carried out using the service braking system from an initial speed of 80 km/h with the engine disconnected
requirements.text: The braking test shall be carried out using the service braking system from an initial speed of 80 km/h with the engine disconnected.

requirements.quote: The stopping distance achieved using a maximum force of 700 N applied to the foot control shall not exceed 61.2 m and
requirements.text: For N1 vehicles approved to Regulation No. 13 fitted with type 1, 2, 3 or 5 temporary-use spare units tested at 80 km/h, the stopping distance with a maximum force of 700 N on the foot control shall not exceed 61.2 m.

requirements.quote: shall be calculated as the deceleration averaged with respect to distance over the interval vb to ve, according to the formula given in paragraph 2.3.1. and shall be not less than 5.0 m/s⁻²
requirements.text: For N1 vehicles fitted with type 1, 2, 3 or 5 temporary-use spare units, the mean fully developed deceleration shall not be less than 5.0 m/s-2.

requirements.quote: The stopping distance achieved using a maximum force of 700 N applied to the foot control, shall not exceed 128.8 m and
requirements.text: For N1 vehicles approved to Regulation No. 13 fitted with type 4 spare units tested at 120 km/h, the stopping distance with a maximum force of 700 N on the foot control shall not exceed 128.8 m.

requirements.quote: The stopping distance achieved using a maximum force of 500 N + 0 / -50 N applied to the foot control, shall not exceed 46.4 m
requirements.text: For N1 vehicles approved to Regulation No. 13-H fitted with type 1, 2, 3 or 5 temporary-use spare units tested at 80 km/h, the stopping distance with a force of 500 N +0/-50 N on the foot control shall not exceed 46.4 m.

requirements.quote: shall be not less than 6.43 m/s⁻²
requirements.text: For N1 vehicles approved to Regulation No. 13-H fitted with type 1, 2, 3 or 5 temporary-use spare units, the mean fully developed deceleration shall not be less than 6.43 m/s-2.

requirements.quote: The stopping distance achieved using a maximum force of 500 N + 0 / -50 N applied to the foot control, shall not exceed 98.4 m
requirements.text: For N1 vehicles approved to Regulation No. 13-H fitted with type 4 temporary-use spare units tested at 120 km/h, the stopping distance with a force of 500 N +0/-50 N on the foot control shall not exceed 98.4 m.

requirements.quote: Tests shall be carried out for each of the fitting conditions of temporary-use spare units specified in paragraph 2.1. of this annex.
requirements.text: The braking and deviation test shall be carried out for each of the fitting conditions of temporary-use spare units specified in Annex 3 paragraph 2.1.

requirements.quote: The prescribed braking performance shall be obtained without any wheel-locking, deviation of the vehicle from its intended course, abnormal vibration, abnormal wear of the tyre during the test or excessive steering correction
requirements.text: The prescribed braking performance shall be obtained without wheel locking, deviation of the vehicle from its intended course, abnormal vibration, abnormal tyre wear or excessive steering correction.

requirements.quote: The ambient temperature shall be between 0 °C and 40 °C.
requirements.text: The run-flat warning system test shall be conducted at an ambient temperature between 0 °C and 40 °C.

requirements.quote: The test road surface shall be dry and smooth.
requirements.text: The run-flat warning system test shall be conducted on a dry and smooth test road surface.

requirements.quote: The test location shall be other than an environment susceptible to radio wave interference such as a strong electric field.
requirements.text: The run-flat warning system test shall be conducted at a location other than an environment susceptible to radio wave interference such as a strong electric field.

requirements.quote: Within 5 minutes after reducing the inflation pressure of the tyre, drive the vehicle normally between 40 and 100 km/h.
requirements.text: Within 5 minutes after reducing the inflation pressure of the tyre, the vehicle shall be driven normally between 40 and 100 km/h during the run-flat warning system test.

requirements.quote: If the warning signal as required in paragraph 2.1.1.5. above has activated, wait 5 minutes before turning the ignition on; the signal must reactivate and remain active
requirements.text: After the warning signal has activated, the signal shall reactivate and remain active when the ignition is switched on again after waiting 5 minutes.

requirements.quote: Repeat the process described in paragraphs 2.1.1.1. to 2.1.1.6., but with a test speed of 130 km/h or higher.
requirements.text: The run-flat detection test shall be repeated with a test speed of 130 km/h or higher and all relevant requirements shall be met for both test speeds.

requirements.quote: The test requirement is satisfied if the system delivers an alert by the time the pressure drop has reached 100 kPa.
requirements.text: Where a gradual pressure loss of between 10 kPa/min and 20 kPa/min is produced on one tyre during driving above 25 km/h, the run-flat warning system shall deliver an alert by the time the pressure drop has reached 100 kPa.

requirements.quote: If the warning signal as required in paragraph 2.2.3. above has activated, wait 5 minutes before turning the ignition on; the signal must reactivate and remain active
requirements.text: After a simulated run-flat warning system failure has activated the malfunction signal, the signal shall reactivate and remain active when the ignition is switched on again after waiting 5 minutes.

requirements.quote: The time to be taken for determination of the requirements of paragraphs 2.1.1.5. and 2.2.3. shall be the total elapsed time while the vehicle is driven in the test speed range 40 km/h to 100 km/h
requirements.text: The time for determination of the run-flat warning requirements shall be the total elapsed time while the vehicle is driven in the test speed range from 40 km/h to 100 km/h.

requirements.quote: Components and separate technical units intended to be fitted in these vehicles with the limitation given in paragraph 3.2.1. with regard to electromagnetic compatibility
requirements.text: The temporary-use spare unit as a component or separate technical unit intended for fitting in an N1 vehicle shall comply with the electromagnetic compatibility requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: The sample(s) shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.
requirements.text: The sample of the electrical/electronic sub-assembly shall be clearly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's trade name or mark and the type designation.

requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3 shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation
requirements.text: The international approval mark shall be affixed in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form.

requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle.

requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation
requirements.text: The electrical/electronic systems or ESAs of the vehicle shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle to comply with this Regulation in normal conditions of use.

requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.text: The ESA shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: Where measured at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the broadband radiated emissions of the vehicle shall not exceed 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band and 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 43 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the broadband radiated emission limit shall remain constant at 43 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: Where measured at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the broadband radiated emissions of the vehicle shall not exceed 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band.

requirements.quote: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: The measured broadband radiated emission values of the vehicle representative of its type, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: Where measured at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m, the narrowband radiated emissions of the vehicle shall not exceed 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz band and 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: Where measured at a vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 3.0 ± 0.05 m, the narrowband radiated emissions of the vehicle shall not exceed 38 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz band and 45 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand a field strength of 30 V/m over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band and a minimum of 25 V/m over the whole band during immunity testing.

requirements.quote: The field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: The vehicle shall withstand a field strength of 10 V/m over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz band and a minimum of 8 V/m over the whole band during immunity testing.

requirements.quote: If tests are made using the method described in Annex 6, in accordance with ISO 11451-4 BCI the current shall be 60 mA in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band
requirements.text: Where the BCI method is used, the vehicle shall withstand a current of 60 mA over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz band and a minimum of 50 mA over the whole band.

requirements.quote: during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions"
requirements.text: The vehicle representative of its type shall show no degradation of performance of immunity related functions during the immunity tests performed in accordance with Annex 6.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band
requirements.text: The broadband electromagnetic interference generated by the ESA shall not exceed 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA broadband interference limit shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.text: The measured broadband interference values of the ESA representative of its type, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.quote: the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band
requirements.text: The narrowband electromagnetic interference generated by the ESA shall not exceed 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz band and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band.

requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.text: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the ESA narrowband interference limit shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.quote: Positive +75 V
requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed positive pulse amplitude emitted by the ESA on the supply lines shall be +75 V.

requirements.quote: Negative -100 V
requirements.text: For vehicles with 12 V systems, the maximum allowed negative pulse amplitude emitted by the ESA on the supply lines shall be -100 V.

requirements.quote: 60 mA
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand a BCI immunity test level of 60 mA in the 20 to 400 MHz range over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: 30 V/m
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand an ALSE immunity test level of 30 V/m in the 80 to 2,000 MHz range over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz band.

requirements.quote: 10 V/m
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand an ALSE immunity test level of 10 V/m in the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz range.

requirements.quote: 50 mA
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand a minimum BCI test level of 50 mA over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.quote: 25 V/m
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand a minimum ALSE test level of 25 V/m over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.

requirements.quote: during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions"
requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall show no degradation of performance of immunity related functions during the immunity tests performed in accordance with Annex 9.

requirements.quote: Starting profile II II 10 pulses
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand the ISO 16750-2 starting profile with immunity test level II and 10 pulses for 12 V and 24 V systems.

requirements.quote: 1 -75 V -450 V 500 pulses
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 1 with an immunity test level of -75 V for 12 V systems and -450 V for 24 V systems over 500 pulses.

requirements.quote: 2a +37 V +37 V 500 pulses
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 2a with an immunity test level of +37 V over 500 pulses.

requirements.quote: 2b +10 V +20 V 10 pulses
requirements.text: The ESA shall withstand test pulse 2b with an immunity test level of +10 V for 12 V systems and +20 V for 24 V systems over 10 pulses.
The ESA shall withstand test pulse 3a with an immunity test level of -112 V for 12 V systems and -150 V for 24 V systems for 1 hour.
The ESA shall withstand test pulse 3b with an immunity test level of +75 V for 12 V systems and +150 V for 24 V systems for 1 hour.

requirements.quote: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2.
requirements.text: Where the vehicle or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with the narrowband emission requirements.

requirements.quote: ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8.
requirements.text: An ESA with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8.

requirements.quote: ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission
requirements.text: An ESA that is not switched, contains no switches or does not include an inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission.

requirements.quote: a = 6 mm min
requirements.text: The approval mark affixed to the vehicle or ESA shall have a dimension a of at least 6 mm.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an outdoor test site (OTS).
requirements.text: The radiated broadband emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or an outdoor test site.

requirements.quote: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.text: Where peak detectors are used for the radiated broadband emission measurements, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

requirements.quote: 30 to 1,000 100/120 kHz 100 ms/MHz 120 kHz 20 s/MHz
requirements.text: When a spectrum analyser is used for the radiated broadband emission measurement, the resolution bandwidth shall be 100/120 kHz for peak detection and 120 kHz for quasi-peak detection between 30 and 1,000 MHz.

requirements.quote: 30 to 1,000 120 kHz 60 kHz 5 ms 120 kHz 60 kHz 1 s
requirements.text: When a scanning receiver is used, the bandwidth at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz with a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 5 ms for peak and 1 s for quasi-peak detection.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle.
requirements.text: The radiated emission measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The same positions shall be used for both horizontal and vertical polarization measurements.
requirements.text: The same antenna positions shall be used for both horizontal and vertical polarization measurements.

requirements.quote: The ignition switch shall be switched on. The engine shall not be operating.
requirements.text: During the narrowband radiated emission measurement, the ignition switch shall be switched on and the engine shall not be operating.

requirements.quote: The vehicle's electronic systems shall all be in normal operating mode with the vehicle stationary.
requirements.text: During the narrowband radiated emission measurement, all of the vehicle's electronic systems shall be in normal operating mode with the vehicle stationary.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be performed with an average detector.
requirements.text: The narrowband radiated emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an outdoor test site (OTS).
requirements.text: The narrowband radiated emission limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or an outdoor test site.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be subject to electromagnetic fields as described in this Annex. The vehicle shall be monitored during the tests.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be subjected to electromagnetic fields as described in Annex 6 and shall be monitored during the immunity tests.

requirements.quote: The engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h if there is no technical reason due to the vehicle to define a different condition.
requirements.text: During the vehicle immunity test the engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h unless a technical reason requires a different condition.

requirements.quote: Speed variation greater than ±10 per cent of the nominal speed. In case of automatic gearbox: change of gear ratio inducing a speed variation greater than ±10 per cent of the nominal speed.
requirements.text: A speed variation greater than ±10 per cent of the nominal speed shall be a failure criterion in the 50 km/h immunity test mode.

requirements.quote: Complete stop of front wiper
requirements.text: A complete stop of the front wiper shall be a failure criterion in the 50 km/h immunity test mode.

requirements.quote: Unexpected activation of horn
requirements.text: Unexpected activation of the horn shall be a failure criterion in the 50 km/h immunity test mode.

requirements.quote: Unexpected activation of brake and unexpected activation of stop lights
requirements.text: Unexpected activation of the brake and of the stop lights shall be a failure criterion in the brake mode immunity test.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range in vertical polarization.

requirements.quote: AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range
requirements.text: The immunity test signal shall be amplitude modulated with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.

requirements.quote: The vehicle shall be positioned with the centre line of the vehicle on the vehicle reference point or line.
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be positioned with its centre line on the vehicle reference point or line during the immunity test.

requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load, during the radiated broadband emission measurement.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1. of this Regulation
requirements.text: The extraneous noise or signal during the ESA broadband emission measurement shall be at least 6 dB below the interference limits of paragraph 6.5.2.1.

requirements.quote: Measurements can be performed with either quasi-peak or peak detectors.
requirements.text: The ESA broadband emission measurements may be performed with either quasi-peak or peak detectors.

requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably at maximum load, during the radiated narrowband emission measurement.

requirements.quote: the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1. of this Regulation
requirements.text: The extraneous noise or signal during the ESA narrowband emission measurement shall be at least 6 dB below the interference limits of paragraph 6.6.2.1.

requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.text: The ESA under test shall be switched on and stimulated to be in normal operating condition during the immunity tests.

requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.text: The ESA immunity measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.quote: The "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2. The test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
requirements.text: The absorber chamber immunity test shall use the substitution method according to ISO 11452-2 and shall be performed with vertical polarization.

requirements.quote: BCI test method with substitution method and injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA
requirements.text: Where the BCI substitution method is used, the injection probe shall be positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.

requirements.quote: BCI test method with closed loop method and injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA
requirements.text: Where the BCI closed loop method is used, the injection probe shall be positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.

requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs
requirements.text: The test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines and to other connections of the ESA.

requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.text: The emission of transient conducted disturbances shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on the supply lines and on other connections of the ESA operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.quote: An onboard speedometer and odometer complying with the requirements of this Regulation shall be fitted to the vehicle to be approved.
requirements.text: The N1 vehicle shall be fitted with an onboard speedometer and odometer complying with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: If more than one onboard speedometer or odometer is fitted to the vehicle, all these speedometers and odometers shall comply with all the requirements of this Regulation when displayed.
requirements.text: Where more than one onboard speedometer or odometer is fitted, all of them shall comply with all the requirements of this Regulation when displayed.

requirements.quote: The display of the speedometer shall be located within the direct field of view of the driver and must be clearly legible both day and night.
requirements.text: The speedometer display shall be located within the direct field of view of the driver and shall be clearly legible both day and night.

requirements.quote: The range of speeds displayed must be sufficiently wide to include the maximum speed of this type of vehicle as stated by the manufacturer.
requirements.text: The range of speeds displayed by the speedometer shall be sufficiently wide to include the maximum speed of the vehicle type as stated by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: In the case of speedometers intended for vehicles of Categories M, N, and L3, L4, L5, and L7 the graduation shall be 1, 2, 5 or 10 km/h.
requirements.text: For the N1 vehicle's speedometer the graduation shall be 1, 2, 5 or 10 km/h.

requirements.quote: when the highest value on the display does not exceed 200 km/h, speed values shall be indicated at intervals not exceeding 20 km/h
requirements.text: Where the highest value on the speedometer display does not exceed 200 km/h, speed values shall be indicated at intervals not exceeding 20 km/h.

requirements.quote: When the maximum value on the display exceeds 200 km/h, then the speed values shall be indicated at intervals not exceeding 30 km/h.
requirements.text: Where the maximum value on the speedometer display exceeds 200 km/h, speed values shall be indicated at intervals not exceeding 30 km/h.

requirements.quote: If a setting makes it possible for the driver to choose between the speed in km/h and mph (miles per hour), then the speed may be displayed only in either km/h or mph at any one time.
requirements.text: Where the driver can choose between km/h and mph, the speed may be displayed only in either km/h or mph at any one time.

requirements.quote: The corresponding unit shall permanently be displayed.
requirements.text: The corresponding speed unit shall permanently be displayed on the speedometer.

requirements.quote: In the case of vehicles of Categories M, N, and L3, L4, L5, and L7 manufactured for sale in any country where imperial units are used, the speedometer shall also be marked in miles per hour (mph); the graduations shall be of 1, 2, 5 or 10 mph.
requirements.text: For N1 vehicles manufactured for sale in a country where imperial units are used, the speedometer shall also be marked in miles per hour with graduations of 1, 2, 5 or 10 mph.

requirements.quote: The numerical values of the speed shall be indicated on the display at intervals not exceeding 20 mph and commencing at 10 or 20 mph.
requirements.text: On the mph scale the numerical values of speed shall be indicated at intervals not exceeding 20 mph commencing at 10 or 20 mph.

requirements.quote: The tyres shall be one of the types normally fitted to the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The speedometer accuracy test shall be carried out with tyres of one of the types normally fitted to the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The test shall be carried out with the vehicle at its unladen weight.
requirements.text: The speedometer accuracy test shall be carried out with the vehicle at its unladen weight.

requirements.quote: The reference temperature at the speedometer shall be 23 ± 5 °C
requirements.text: The reference temperature at the speedometer during the accuracy test shall be 23 ± 5 °C.

requirements.quote: During each test the pressure of the tyres shall be the normal running pressure as defined in paragraph 2.4.
requirements.text: During each speedometer accuracy test the tyre pressure shall be the normal running pressure as defined in paragraph 2.4.

requirements.quote: 45 < Vmax ≤ 100 40 km/h and 80 % Vmax (if the resulting speed is ≥ 55 km/h)
requirements.text: For a vehicle with a maximum design speed above 45 km/h and up to 100 km/h, the speedometer shall be tested at 40 km/h and at 80 per cent of Vmax if the resulting speed is at least 55 km/h.

requirements.quote: 100 < Vmax ≤ 150 40 km/h, 80 km/h and 80 % Vmax (if the resulting speed is ≥ 100 km/h)
requirements.text: For a vehicle with a maximum design speed above 100 km/h and up to 150 km/h, the speedometer shall be tested at 40 km/h, 80 km/h and 80 per cent of Vmax if the resulting speed is at least 100 km/h.

requirements.quote: 150 < Vmax 40 km/h, 80 km/h and 120 km/h
requirements.text: For a vehicle with a maximum design speed above 150 km/h, the speedometer shall be tested at 40 km/h, 80 km/h and 120 km/h.

requirements.quote: The test instrumentation used for measuring the true vehicle speed shall be accurate to ± 0.5 per cent;
requirements.text: The test instrumentation used for measuring the true vehicle speed shall be accurate to ± 0.5 per cent.

requirements.quote: If a roller dynamometer is used for the test, the diameter of the roller should be at least 0.4 m;
requirements.text: Where a roller dynamometer is used for the speedometer test, the diameter of the roller shall be at least 0.4 m.
At the specified test speeds, the speed indicated by the speedometer shall not be less than the true speed and shall satisfy 0 ≤ (V1 - V2) ≤ 0.1 V2 + 4 km/h.

requirements.quote: The display of the odometer shall be visible or accessible to the driver.
requirements.text: The display of the odometer shall be visible or accessible to the driver.

requirements.quote: The odometer shall display at least an integer number composed of a minimum of 6 numerals for the vehicles of categories M and N
requirements.text: For the N1 vehicle the odometer shall display at least an integer number composed of a minimum of 6 numerals.

requirements.quote: In the case of vehicles manufactured for sale in any country where imperial units are used, the odometer shall be marked in miles.
requirements.text: For N1 vehicles manufactured for sale in a country where imperial units are used, the odometer shall be marked in miles.

requirements.quote: The odometer shall display the distance in the unit corresponding to that of the predominant speedometer scale.
requirements.text: The odometer shall display the distance in the unit corresponding to that of the predominant speedometer scale.

requirements.quote: If a setting makes it possible for the driver to select the odometer display distance in km or miles independently of the speedometer, the odometer shall identify the unit used.
requirements.text: Where the driver can select the odometer display distance in km or miles independently of the speedometer, the odometer shall identify the unit used.

requirements.quote: The total distance indicated shall not deviate by more than ±4.0 per cent from the true distance travelled as determined in paragraph 5.7.
requirements.text: The total distance indicated by the odometer shall not deviate by more than ±4.0 per cent from the true distance travelled.

requirements.quote: these values shall not deviate from the (rounded) total distance indicated
requirements.text: Where total distance values are provided via the serial data port on the standardised data link connector, these values shall not deviate from the rounded total distance indicated.

requirements.quote: Total distance values and the total distance indicated shall have a resolution better than or equal to 1 km or 1 mile, as appropriate.
requirements.text: Total distance values and the total distance indicated shall have a resolution better than or equal to 1 km or 1 mile.

requirements.quote: In the case of an electrically detectable failure preventing the odometer requirements of this UN Regulation from being met, a malfunction indication shall be provided to the driver
requirements.text: Where an electrically detectable failure prevents the odometer requirements from being met, a malfunction indication shall be provided to the driver.

requirements.quote: The malfunction indication shall be active when the malfunction occurs and shall remain active as long as the malfunction persists.
requirements.text: The odometer malfunction indication shall be active when the malfunction occurs and shall remain active as long as the malfunction persists.

requirements.quote: The total distance indicated and total distance values shall be protected against manipulation.
requirements.text: The total distance indicated and total distance values shall be protected against manipulation.

requirements.quote: In the case of vehicles of categories M and N: 0 ≤ (V1 - V2) ≤ 0.1 V2 + 6 km/h;
requirements.text: During conformity of production checks for the N1 vehicle, the speed indicated (V1) and the actual speed (V2) shall satisfy 0 ≤ (V1 - V2) ≤ 0.1 V2 + 6 km/h.

requirements.quote: The tyres shall be one of the types normally fitted to the vehicle as defined in paragraph 2.3. of this Regulation.
requirements.text: The odometer accuracy test shall be carried out with tyres of one of the types normally fitted to the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The reference temperature at the odometer shall be 23 ± 5 °C
requirements.text: The reference temperature at the odometer during the accuracy test shall be 23 ± 5 °C.

requirements.quote: During each test, the pressure of the tyres shall be the normal running pressure as defined in paragraph 2.4.
requirements.text: During each odometer accuracy test the tyre pressure shall be the normal running pressure as defined in paragraph 2.4.

requirements.quote: The test instrumentation used for measuring the true distance travelled shall be accurate to ± 0.5 per cent.
requirements.text: The test instrumentation used for measuring the true distance travelled shall be accurate to ± 0.5 per cent.

requirements.quote: The vehicle is tested at a speed which may vary between 0 and 100 km/h.
requirements.text: The odometer accuracy test shall be performed at a speed varying between 0 and 100 km/h.

requirements.quote: The vehicle is driven for a minimum of 10 kilometres or 7 miles as indicated on the odometer
requirements.text: The vehicle shall be driven for a minimum of 10 kilometres or 7 miles as indicated on the odometer during the odometer accuracy test.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and shall be indelible.
requirements.text: The approval mark affixed to the vehicle shall be clearly legible and indelible.

requirements.quote: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.
requirements.text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

requirements.quote: A circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval
requirements.text: The approval mark shall comprise a circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which granted approval.

requirements.quote: a = 8 mm min.
requirements.text: The approval mark affixed to the vehicle shall have a dimension a of at least 8 mm.
